Original Review:
Trying to get an appointment is impossible, i called at 8AM to be met with 30 people in front of me. I have been put down to go on antidepressants since December but whenever i have tried to phone up regarding making an appointment for this there has never been an available appointment. Once again, even though i called at 8AM there was ‘no appointments available’ and i was just told to call again tomorrow.
In October i had to contact the crisis team where i was recommended to put myself down as a temporary patient at Ashgrove (before i filled out everything properly to be an actual patient as i’d just moved to the area). When i went in to enquire about it the receptionist was nothing but rude to me and began talking down to me about how they don’t take temporary patients, my bad i guess??? In front of a full waiting room i had to explain that i’d had a crisis and this was what i was told to do. I don’t recommend this The level of care provided is excellent and they will push for referrals where they deem it necessary. However, they often have zero appointments available and force you to try at 8am each day and hope you get a slot.

10th August 2024 - no appointments available even though I called at 8:17am (12th in the queue). Call back at 8am tomorrow was the only option....

July 2024: Doctor amazing, booking a pain

Awaiting an x-ray, received a letter to call the surgery for a telephone consultation. Called to be told I cannot book one and to call at 8am and try for an appointment then. Also informed that due to the Eisteddfod there are no physical appointments at all. I called at 8am and was on hold for 20 mins but did get an appointment.

July 2023:

The level of care provided was excellent. There was however a 2 week delay between requesting  an appointment to seeing the doctor, the doctor was kind, considerate and thorough in dealing with my needs.

________ Overall review _________

There are rarely any appointments available (while University is active) and when you do try and get one (have to call at 8am - can't even schedule for X weeks time normally).

When you call outside of the 8am insanity do not expect to be able to book an appointment. Previously we were told that none were available and we COULD NOT book any appointment in the future as they have none available for the next 3 weeks and the next block had not opened up. It took 3 days of early morning calls to finally get an appointment.

This system is useless as the only time it is worthwhile to call (they insist you call at 8am) is when most people are commuting/getting children ready and some are actually unable to call due to work/life commitments.

They will suggest (and if you are trying to help reduce the strain, you will use) the e-consult service instead. It offers options of how you wish to be contacted including by phone (useful when they don't answer the query and you have to submit a fresh one). They respond with a frankly sharp email stating that it is an e-consult, not a booking system, they won't call and to call them for a phone appointment instead.

In regard to the response from Ashgrove - my experience when appointments are not available is that the staff do not offer alternatives other than to call again the next day early morning.
